metadata.title: Compare-MeFileHash
metadata.description: A super simple file hash verification script I wrote for myself in about 10 minutes on a rainy December afternoon. I just slapped this together for myself to use and am really only publishing it to PSGallery for the purposes of easily pushing it to domain-connected PCs in my network. Anyone is welcome to use it but it should be expected that ZERO SUPPORT, modifications, fixes, or updates will ever be provided by me in the future for any reason. This script is ENTIRELY unmaintained by the author, and you use it at your own risk. That being said, if anyone wants to modify it, reuse it, or improve it themselves for their own use, they are more than welcome to and are more than welcome to re-publish it or re-share it including without crediting me if you don't feel like it.
